hero.title: Iungo Convert
hero.presentation: The only Sales Agent that knows your PIM catalog and the CDP profile in real time.
hero.description: It identifies intent. It recommends the product. It negotiates terms. It closes the sale. And it makes a clean handoff to a human when that makes sense — with full context.
hero.imageAlt: Iungo Convert illustration with a sales funnel, customer profiles, and conversion indicators.

handoff.title: When it hands off to a human seller, it hands off everything.
handoff.description: 95% of chatbots pass the customer to a human "from zero". Iungo Convert passes a ready briefing:

summary.title: SUMMARY
summary.description: Intent, objections raised, accepted price range, and perceived urgency.

products.title: PRODUCTS
products.description: Top 3 suggestions already calibrated, with stock and margin confirmed.

profile.title: PROFILE
profile.description: History, LTV, segment, whether they are VIP, and brand allergies or preferences.

nextAction.title: NEXT ACTION
nextAction.description: A concrete recommendation: "offer interest-free installments and close on WhatsApp".

testimonials.title: Sales that close on their own — and open the door for the seller.
testimonials.description: Sales directors who stopped losing hot demand after hours and started handing a warm pipeline to the team.

daniel.quote: We used to lose hot site visits after hours. Today Iungo Convert closes at 1 a.m. and hands a ready ticket to the human seller only for B2B cases. Average ticket doubled in the digital operation.
daniel.name: Daniel P.
daniel.role: Sales Director · Outdoor footwear · under NDA

vivian.quote: Drift and Intercom recommended in a generic way. Iungo recommends by looking at the real catalog — and at the customer history in the CDP. A better recommendation means higher conversion. No mystery.
vivian.name: Vivian K.
vivian.role: Head of Digital Sales · Fashion marketplace

why.title: It knows the catalog. It knows the customer. It knows the moment.
why.description: Drift, Intercom, and Regie.ai run on scripts. Iungo Convert runs on the live data of your operation.

catalog.title: It recommends with technical criteria
catalog.description: It knows compatibility, specifications, stock, and the current price. It suggests the right product, not the most expensive one.

profile.title: It adapts tone and offer
profile.description: If they are VIP, it offers a pre-sale. If they are price-sensitive, it offers a coupon. If they are B2B, it offers corporate terms.

moment.title: It acts at the right instant
moment.description: Behavior Engine triggers: 3rd visit to the same category, premium cart abandonment, and a price drop on a favorited item.
